hooks.name: AI Change Logger
hooks.description: After each agent turn, inspects the git diff and appends a dated summary of the agent's own code changes to AI_CHANGELOG.md in the repo root.

action.prompt:
You just finished an agent turn. Document the meaningful code changes YOU made this turn by appending an entry to AI_CHANGELOG.md in the repository root. Follow these steps precisely.

STEP 1 — Inspect the diff
- Run `git status --porcelain` and `git diff HEAD` (plus `git diff --staged` if relevant) to see what changed.
- Identify only the files YOU created, modified, or deleted during this turn. Ignore changes that were already present and made by the user.

STEP 2 — Decide whether to log
- If you made NO project changes this turn, STOP. Do not write anything. Do not create an empty entry.
- Exclude AI_CHANGELOG.md itself from consideration — never log changes to the changelog.
- If the only changes are to AI_CHANGELOG.md, STOP and write nothing.

STEP 3 — Avoid duplicates
- Read the existing AI_CHANGELOG.md (if it exists). If the current changes are already documented in a recent entry, do not add a duplicate entry.

STEP 4 — Append the entry
- Append (never overwrite) a new entry to AI_CHANGELOG.md. Preserve all existing history.
- If AI_CHANGELOG.md does not exist, create it, then add the entry.
- Group changes by feature or functionality.
- Use today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Use exactly this Markdown structure:

## YYYY-MM-DD - Short description

### Changes
- What changed and why.

### Files Modified
- `filename` — explanation.

### Technical Details
- Important implementation details, bug fixes, and architectural decisions.

### Testing
- Tests performed and their ACTUAL results.

STRICT RULES
- Append new entries only; never overwrite previous history.
- Do NOT log changes made by the user — only your own changes.
- Do NOT log changes to AI_CHANGELOG.md itself.
- Do NOT create empty entries when no project changes occurred.
- Do NOT modify any project source code while generating the changelog. The only file you may write is AI_CHANGELOG.md.
- Never claim a test passed unless it was actually run this turn. If no tests were run, say so honestly (e.g. "No tests were run this turn.").
- Avoid duplicate entries.
- Never stage or commit changes (no `git add`, `git commit`, etc.). Read-only git commands for inspecting the diff are fine.
